name: myvoices-tts
description: Voice synthesis for streaming. Cloned voices, presets and saved phrases via XTTSv2, Piper, F5-TTS and Chatterbox. Requires the MyVoices desktop app to be running.
long_description: MyVoices integrates four TTS engines with voice cloning and a REST/MCP API. This extension connects Claude Desktop to a locally-running MyVoices instance via mcp_server.exe (bundled in dist\MyVoices\). No internet connection required.

myvoices_dir.title: Carpeta de MyVoices
myvoices_dir.description: Carpeta dist\MyVoices que contiene MyVoices.exe y mcp_server.exe. Ejemplo: C:\Users\TuUsuario\Desktop\MyVoices
